items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) felt lack of power/explosion, stopped practice; will work out pregame and is questionable. Injury believed minor.
items.why: Calf issue during practice; McVay confirmed pregame test.
items.implication: Game-time decision; if out, targets redistribute heavily to TEs/WRs.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen.
items.why: Based on McVay comments and depth.
items.implication: TE-heavy target tree if Puka sits.

items.text: Colston Loveland is BACK (thank Caleb). Since Williams return: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/game, 6+ rec and 60+ yards both games.
items.why: Production spike with Caleb; now clear path post-Kmet.
items.implication: TE1 upside ROS with Kmet IR.

items.text: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) OUT Week 7. 49ers D inflating opposing RB production 4.4% (7th-most); recent RBs saw solid receiving. Sweet setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.why: DvP data + recent catch numbers to opposing RBs (White, Holani, Harvey, Love).
items.implication: Bijan full workload + receiving upside vs soft matchup.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/targets/snaps for Bijan with no Brob.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts Sunday: awesome player/scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt. Not because of National TE Day.
items.why: WR injuries force more TE involvement in scheme.

items.text: Lamar Jackson: 'Right now, I'm headed in the right direction.' Dealing with high ankle sprain.
items.implication: Trending toward possible return; monitor practice.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle/high-ankle) ruled OUT again this week by coach Mike LaFleur.
Colts HC Shane Steichen ruled out TE Tyler Warren (groin) and CB Sauce Gardner (calf) for Sunday vs Vikings.
items.implication: TE targets to others; Colts pass-catching thinned.

items.text: Bucs HC Todd Bowles: Baker Mayfield 'looks like he’s ready to go' and expected to start Sunday vs Panthers (thumb). Egbuka ruled out (concussion).
items.implication: Mayfield QB2 upside; Egbuka absence caps ceiling, Godwin etc. benefit.
items.opportunity: Mayfield return boosts TB pass game; Egbuka OUT opens WR targets.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson has played just 21% of snaps over the last three weeks.
items.opportunity: Low snap/route share limiting fantasy floor/ceiling.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes this season but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet injury may reduce 2-/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Route % + YPRR efficiency; personnel shift from Kmet IR.

items.text: The more I watch Jaylen Warren, the more I love his game. Steelers have something special.
Josh Jacobs allowed in facility meetings/lifting/medical (non-football). MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) poor; OL mess too. Long-term outlook discussed.
items.why: Facility access positive signal; backups inefficient.
items.implication: Jacobs return timeline/outlook improved vs poor handcuffs.
items.opportunity: Jacobs role secure when back; backups not stealing.
